digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface — config ownership cutover
propositions: 12 flagged ambient config/credential reads in the reconciler JIRA adapter/credential surface are recorded as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows and block RP-04 completion while sitting below the seam enforced by the AST gate check_config_ownership.py

11 of 12 flagged reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, acli timeout, comment max chars, pandoc timeout, cutover clients) are composed-config values that must be routed through owned config.py resolvers to move the ambient read into the composition root, preserving live-per-call env-over-file precedence

1 flagged read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE subsystem debug switch) is not composed config and must remain in-place with a # read-via: marker, with a cap of exactly 1 marked line across the 6 source files
Secret boundary reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) are owner=credential and already owned; they remain unchanged and out of scope

The cutover must pass the held-out oracle test that verifies no finding in the 6 listed source files, zero LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for those files, and exactly 1 # read-via: marker total across them

All affected test consumers must be updated to drive the cut env/config through the new owned resolvers while preserving JIRA endpoint live-precedence, fail-loud insecure-url, DC fail-loud, and acli-timeout-clamp behavior
